source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.0, data build 963, released 2026-09-30

data.summary: Picking this unit for shooting in your [Shooting Phase](vsdata:core-rule/shooting-phase) gives you the option to Empower it at a cost of one [Pain token](vsdata:ability/drukhari.power-from-pain). Once it finishes, choose one enemy unit that took a hit from its shooting. The chosen unit cannot claim [Benefit of Cover](vsdata:core-rule/benefit-of-cover) for the rest of that phase.
